name: CMAQ AERO6/AERO7 crustal and sea-salt cation speciation
purpose: Diagnostic Ca2+, K+, Mg2+ (and Na+ from dust) passed to ISORROPIA II; mass fractions of the parent SCRAM species. They are non-volatile and are not transported as separate tracers.

provenance.file: kernel/reference/cmaq/AERO_DATA_v55_ae7.F (group CMAQ v5.5 cb6r5_ae7_aq); identical tables in USEPA/CMAQ main 9bd3734176479c2e49139fea98e1d5e8a16170e3 aero6/AERO_DATA.F
provenance.dust_fine: dust_spc fine (J) column, lines 'Sodium','Calcium','Magnesium','Potassium': median of SPECIATE desert soil profiles 3398, 3403, 3408, 3413
provenance.dust_coarse: asoil_{na,ca,mg,k}_fac, applied to ASOIL (the coarse non-anion dust, 0.95358 of coarse dust): SPECIATE profiles 3399, 3404, 3409, 3414
provenance.sea_salt: sea_spc fine column Na 0.30860, Ca 0.01180, Mg 0.03680, K 0.01140; expressed here relative to Na because SCRAM's sea-salt species PNA is sodium. The coarse ascat_*_fac give the same ratios (Mg/Na 0.1191, K/Na 0.0370, Ca/Na 0.0382).

dust_coarse_note: coarse values = asoil_*_fac (Na 0.0626, Ca 0.0838, Mg 0.0170, K 0.0242) x 0.95358 (ASOIL share of coarse dust), so that they are fractions of total coarse dust mass like the fine values
